species.name: Crappie
why: Water 53°F on top, much colder than they like, so they move slowly and stay deep.
Best water today is 6–28 ft deep, mostly on flats.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 75 ft, cold below.
Little oxygen below about 115 ft, so fish stay above it.

species.name: White bass
why: Water 53°F on top, much colder than they like, so they move slowly and stay deep.
Best water today is 8–28 ft deep, mostly on wind-blown banks.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 75 ft, cold below.
Little oxygen below about 115 ft, so fish stay above it.
Northwest wind at 15 mph pushes bait onto the southeast shore: try the wind-blown banks.
